body:
Land-model support, released as v1.5.0:

- `screen_level_values`: 2 m temperature and humidity and 10 m wind from the MOST profiles of a solve; new field `SurfaceFluxConditions.ζ_eff`.
- The surface state applies at the displacement height: the surface geopotential is `Φ_sfc + g d`, the dry static energy difference driving the sensible heat flux is `cp (T_int − T_sfc) + g (Δz − d)`, and the surface density is extrapolated over `Δz − d`. Results change for `d ≠ 0` (by `g d/cp` in the temperature difference, 0.15 K at `d = 15` m); raising `d` and the reference level together now leaves the exchange unchanged. `surface_geopotential(inputs)` is deprecated in favor of `surface_geopotential(param_set, inputs)`.
- Reference level conventions: `SurfaceFluxConfig` gains `reference_level`, `ReferenceAboveSurface()` by default or `ReferenceAboveApparentSink()` (`Δz` measured from `d + z0m`, as in CLM), converted before the solve by `reference_above_surface`.
- Raupach canopy roughness: `displacement_height`, an optional frontal-area-index floor `λ_min` (zero by default), and the former hard-coded constants as fields; notation and equation numbers follow Raupach (1994). `frontal_area_ratio` enters the drag partition (Eq. 7) only; the displacement height (Eq. 8) is a fit in the plant area index.
- Fix: the Raupach displacement height (Eq. 8) now uses the canopy area index `Λ` (the plant area index) instead of the frontal area index `λ = Λ/2`, matching Fig. 1b of the paper. `d/h` increases (0.66 vs. 0.56 at `Λ = 1`) and `z0m/h` decreases.
- `surface_fluxes` returns `NaN` with `converged = false` when `Δz - d <= max(z0m, z0h)`; `check_reference_height` validates on the host.
- Gustiness floor accessors `minimum_wind_speed(spec, param_set)` and `without_floor(spec)`.

See `NEWS.md` for details.
title: Add screen-level recovery, canopy displacement height, and reference-height checks
